title: Durch die Mandschurei und Sibirien. Reisen und Studien
author: Rudolf Zabel
title_en: Through Manchuria and Siberia: Travels and Studies
format_note: The original is in the German language (Leipzig, 1902), printed in Fraktur (blackletter) type. Transcribe in ordinary Latin letters but keep the 1902 spelling exactly as printed (e.g. thun, Theil, giebt, Thür); write long s (ſ) as s and keep ß. Letter-spaced (gesperrt) words are emphasis: write them unspaced in *italics*. Words set in Roman (Antiqua) type within the Fraktur can be left as plain text. Ignore the 'Digitized by Google' watermark.
